node.title: Re: Docker Container Started With Docker-Compose and <STDIN>
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
my $input = ; It is clear that this will not work in my container because there is no standard input. I want it to fail and bail out. The problem is that it never returns. How can I detect that situation in a clean way?

If you want to detect whether the user can enter input (not directly whether it's running inside a Docker container), I'd suggest [mod://IO::Interactive], or at the very least [doc://-X|-t STDIN]. Or, you could use a [id://1190704|prompting module] instead, depending on what you're actually trying to implement.
